recentItems.title: మురసు  బీభత్సం..ఇంకా 24 గంటలు డేంజర్! | Murasu Cyclone news Updates | AP Weather report | iDream
recentItems.description:
#MurasuCyclone, #APWeather, #CycloneMurasu, #AndhraPradeshNews, #TeluguNews, #IMDAlert, #WeatherUpdate, #HeavyRains,
మురసు  బీభత్సం..ఇంకా 24 గంటలు డేంజర్! | Murasu Cyclone news Updates | AP Weather report | iDream 


Landfall Details: Severe Cyclonic Storm 'Murasu' crossed the South Andhra Pradesh coast near Ongole (between Nellore and Narsapur), bringing intense gale winds.   Wind Speed & Fury: The cyclone battered coastal belts with fierce wind speeds touching 100–130 km/h during landfall, uprooting century-old trees and electric poles.   Severe Waterlogging: Heavy torrential downpours left major roads and low-lying areas in districts like Prakasam, Bapatla, Guntur, Krishna, and NTR submerged under knee-deep water.   Continued High Alert: Meteorological authorities and district collectors warn that high alert protocols must stay active as heavy rainfall threats persist for the next 24 hours.   Rough Sea Conditions: The sea remains highly turbulent with danger signals hoisted; fishermen are strictly advised not to venture into the Bay of Bengal.   Crop & Infrastructure Loss: Standing crops (including banana and paddy fields) nearing harvest faced extensive damage, compounding losses from the earlier cyclone.Government & Relief Measures: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu held emergency reviews, and Union Home Minister Amit Shah assured central assistance while NDRF and SDRF teams lead rapid rescue and power restoration operations.   Telangana & Dam Inflows: Intermittent rains touched parts of Telangana, raising hopes for depleting groundwater levels and reservoir capacities like Singur and Manjira.
